scripts.datasets:sync: bun run datasets:index && bun run --cwd apps/site seed:sync-notes && bun run --cwd apps/site data:catalog
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/countries/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/datasets/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/views/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/figures/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test packages src/*.test.ts src/worker/*.test.ts src/map/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/datasets registry:check && bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:worker && bun run typecheck:ingestion && bun run test && bun run lint:articles && bun run check:ontology && bun run check:dataset-versions && bun run check:dataset-index && bun run build && bun run check:site
scripts.cf:dev: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler dev --config wrangler.explore.jsonc
scripts.cf:dev:explore: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler dev --config wrangler.explore.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler d1 migrations apply developing-country-platform --config wrangler.explore.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler d1 migrations apply developing-country-platform --config wrangler.explore.jsonc --remote
scripts.deploy:explore: bun run build:explore && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config wrangler.explore.jsonc
scripts.dry-run:explore: bun run build:explore && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config wrangler.explore.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-explore
scripts.dry-run:site: bun run build:site && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN bun run --cwd apps/site wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-site
scripts.lint:articles: for d in analysis/*/; do bun scripts/lint-article.mjs "$d" > /dev/null || { bun scripts/lint-article.mjs "$d"; exit 1; }; done
